issue.title: Bug: .format(...) called on pytest_assert rather than string within in test_show_chassis_module

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Low

### Description of the bug

`.format(...)` is called on `pytest_assert(x, y)` instead of error string y due to bracketing issue. This causes unintended errors/failures of `AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'format'`

### Steps to Reproduce

Run `platform_tests/cli/test_show_chassis_module.py::test_show_chassis_module_status_after_docker_restart` on suitable platform

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

It should format on the string within the `pytest_assert` (bracketings should be fixed)
